svg.title: V-Lo database structure
svg.text: Supabase (Postgres). Arrows are foreign keys: they point from the row that refers to the row it refers to.

text.tspan: lifter, not to a team: their

svg.text: where the plan meets the sensors
a programme: a team's, or one person's own
a plan given to one athlete
one training day for one athlete
Foreign key: the row at the tail refers to the row the arrow points at.
Tag instead of a line: this column refers to profiles (a person) or teams. Drawn as a tag so lines don't cross the whole picture.
PK = primary key, each row's own id. All ids are uuids. A person's id is the same as their login id.
Plans belong to a team (team_id) or to one person (owner_id). Workouts without assignment_id are free workouts the athlete logged without a plan.
Roles live in team_members, per team: one login can coach one team, train in another, and record its own sets with no team at all.
Deleting a plan, assignment or workout never deletes recordings: the set log's recording_id just becomes empty.
